<thought>We have three resistors in ratio 1:2:3, total measured resistance 16.364 Ω between X2 and B. Assuming a simple series chain gives R_total = 6k, so k = 2.727 Ω. Thus R1≈2.727 Ω, R2≈5.455 Ω, R3≈8.182 Ω. A series topology with two internal nodes (N1, N2) matches the measurement. This is the most straightforward topology consistent with the given data.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1": 2.727, "R2": 5.455, "R3": 8.182}, "connections": [["X2","N1","R1"], ["N1","N2","R2"], ["N2","B","R3"]]}</final_answer>
